lanes.summary: Data lives in the MacroFactor account and follows sign-in to any device, and the Apple Watch app logs food and weight but may need a manual "Sync All Data"; there is no household sharing, and a shared recipe link imports the recipe into the other person's account.

Onboarding is a 3-step "Let's get started" checklist, the dashboard shows zeroed cards and "---" placeholders with a food search bar, and logger lists say what goes there and how to fill them ("No history yet / Search for foods below", "No recipes yet / Use the + above to add recipes").
